articles.title: NHL EDGE stats: Rangers’ outlook with Shesterkin injured
Hockey x Peanuts: Connecting Generations for Generations
Bowness says Blue Jackets 'should be very angry with where we are'

away.summary: The Rangers will start Dylan Garand in goal due to the season-ending injury to Igor Shesterkin. Garand has been strong in his starts, posting a .932 save percentage and winning all three of his appearances. The team remains competitive offensively, led by Alexis Lafrenière's breakout season, and ranks among the league leaders in penalty kill and goal differential.

home.summary: The Columbus Blue Jackets are struggling defensively, allowing a league-worst 4.20 goals per game and sitting 30th in goals-against. Coach Rick Bowness expressed frustration with the team's effort and preparation, noting they have not played since a 7-3 loss to the Florida Panthers. No specific lineup or goalie information for the upcoming game against the Rangers was provided in the articles.
